parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A beaker of boiling water is placed on the pan of a balance, as illustrated in Fig. 2.1.

{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

The water is maintained at its boiling point by means of a heater. The change $M$ in the balance reading in $300\ \text{s}$ is determined for two different input powers to the heater. The results are shown in Fig. 2.2.

| voltmeter reading / $\text{V}$ | ammeter reading / $\text{A}$ | $M / \text{g}$ |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 11.5 | 5.2 | 5.0 |
| 14.2 | 6.4 | 9.1 |

Fig. 2.2

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Energy is supplied continuously by the heater. State where, in this experiment,

1. external work is done,

2. internal energy increases. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Use data in Fig. 2.2 to determine the specific latent heat of vaporisation of water.
